title: Kissed Dense Middle Eastern Lamb Kebabs
description: A romantic and flavorful Middle Eastern dish featuring lamb, red pepper flakes, and a crispy exterior, perfect for a special occasion, and buddhist-temple-friendly as it does not contain any forbidden ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb, red pepper flakes, olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika, and mix well.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
In a shallow dish, mix together flour, eggs, and breadcrumbs.
Remove the lamb from the marinade, allowing any excess to drip off.
Dip each piece of lamb into the flour mixture, coating evenly.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Deep-fry the lamb pieces in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the lamb from the oil and place on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Serve the lamb kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
